messages:
maria: Quick idea for safer runtime rollouts: add `reserve_ratio` (fraction of capacity reserved for SLO-critical routes) and `slo_priority` (enum: low/normal/high) on route configs. Want quick reactions before an RFC.
ben: Can you sketch how reserve_ratio differs from quota_floor? they feel similar.
maria: quota_floor is absolute tokens. reserve_ratio is relative to current pool capacity (e.g., 0.1 means keep 10% of pool for SLO routes). More robust when capacity scales.
kai: makes sense. How will the router use slo_priority?
maria: Router ranks candidates by cost, but we add a penalty for lower priority routes when computing shifts. High priority routes get preferential allocation from reserve.
bui: ui-porch: the console needs to show both absolute and relative metrics; ops care about tokens left and percent reserved. Could be confusing otherwise.
maria: agreed. Plan console panel: top row shows res_ratio and absolute reserved tokens calc; middle: live SLO compliance %; bottom: recent reassigns with reasons. Include a toggle for "dry-evaluate" so product owners can preview changes without routing.
ben: telemetry: emit a structured `config.safeguard.engaged` event whenever reserve kicks in, with fields: route, reserve_ratio, capacity_snapshot, active_reserve_tokens, reason.
ops-bot: I can emit that event. Also will include a `dry_evaluate=true` tag when in preview mode. :robot_face:
kai: rollout semantics: make reserve_ratio opt-in per service for first rollout. Also add an automated pause if reserve consumption > 80% for 10m.
maria: pause vs ramp? I'd prefer ramp-down of cheaper variants first, then pause. Avoid abrupt user-facing regressions. Default ramp window 3m, configurable.
ben: compatibility: older clients should ignore unknown fields. Server side validation must reject invalid enums. Add a schema version field: `config_schema_v: "v2"` when fields present.
maria: good call. Migration plan: server accepts v1/v2, console only shows new UI when v2 enabled. We'll default new routes to v1 unless owner flips to v2.
ui-porch: UX question: owners want an "explain" link that simulates N% p95 increase and shows what routes would shift. We can reuse dry-evaluate.
kai: testing: perf to run an A/B weekend with synthetic p95 pressure, observability to validate metrics and that alerts fire when reserve >80%. Ops to practice the rollback CTA.
maria: I'll open the draft RFC with schema, console mocks, telemetry event spec, and a migration checklist. tagging @ben for API review and @ops-bot for event payload.
ben: one more: add a `sampled_telemetry` flag so we don't double our metric volume during rollout. Small sample to validate correctness is fine.
maria: ok, add `telemetry_sample_rate` default 0.05. Thanks all, PR coming later today.
ops-bot: added TODO ticket for `config.safeguard.engaged` event in tracing pipeline. Will add test harness for dry_evaluate traces. :white_check_mark:
